name: cloudflare-garmin-mcp

scripts.test: npm run build && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "*_test.py"

description: Read-only Garmin MCP server for Cloudflare Workers Free.

GARMIN_SESSION.description: A separate Garmin session JSON. Keep it private. See the repository setup guide.

GARMIN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Base64-encoded 32 random bytes. Preserve this key across deployments.

OWNER_ACCESS_HASH.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of your separate owner access code.

PUBLIC_ORIGIN.description: Leave empty to use the Worker URL, or enter its exact HTTPS origin.
